Detail: Reference for how Maja generates polls/quizzes every ~4 hours
OPENAI_MODEL default gpt-4o-mini (OpenRouter if key starts with sk-or-)
Two stages, one card: (1) English Content Agent writes prompt/label only; (2) Hindi Localization Agent writes promptHi/labelHi after English is finalized
~20 cards per onboarding category per refresh
No short TTL — previous live moments retired only after the new batch is live

Agent System Prompt = English-only LLM system message. Agent User Payload = JSON user message schema. Shared Rules = rules[] sent every category. Category Scope/Rules = sports vs cricket extras. Evergreen Polls/Quizzes = bank templates. Brief Templates = verified event cards. Meme Pack = memegen image polls. Hindi Localize = second-pass localization prompt (never invents cards). Poll Gen & Feed = how polls are created and shown in the swipe feed. Trends Input = ops-maintained India trends JSON per category.
Ops fill backend/scripts/content_gen/trends/{category}.json before refresh. Merged with briefs into verifiedTrends. Model must not invent trending claims.
